blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–King James Reyes won bronze in the men’s 1,500-meter T46 on Friday, giving the Philippines its first athletics medal at the 5th Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya in Japan. Reyes, 24, clocked a personal-best 4 minutes, 13.81 seconds at Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium. The Loreto, Agusan del Sur, native lost an arm after falling from a macopa tree when he was 5.
